notes: The universe remains degenerate in known ways and W24 closes none of them; it adds a decision the strategy layer does not yet make. Five of seven unrestricted strategies still end holding all 51 reachable v1 nodes, so cross-strategy containment stays 1.000 and several acceptance criteria are saturated rather than failed -- and university-siting.test.ts measures that saturation directly: two universes at opposite ends of the 80x terrain spread both end at exactly 51 nodes known, because 51 is the ruleset ceiling. These three gate sweeps are 100 percent passive-control and submit no god verb, so the only university any of them holds is the seeded academy at the documented default site, which is neutral in both siting mechanisms by construction. capitalSnowball is NOT asserted by this file.
rationale: W24 university-siting: territory moves from a content aggregate into world state, and a university stands in a kind of country. Regenerated ONCE, at the end of the change, against the whole tree. contentRevision moves a622452a3b55e38fd902a2d3264b44d7 -> 5be755471cd46620625b01b77d2888a7 because every territory.json record gained libraryUpkeepMultiplier (contracts.md 2.7); no existing content value changed a byte, and that hash change alone invalidates all three baselines regardless of what the numbers did. WHAT MOVED, AND THE ONE MECHANISM BEHIND IT. Against the superseded baselines, 29 of the 30 measured figures are inside tolerance and most are inside one standard error: at 600 ticks referenceNodesKnown 29.46 -> 29.60 (1.25 SE), referenceLibraryDepth 10.285 -> 10.240 (-0.13 SE), referencePopulation 129.395 -> 129.255 (-0.32 SE); at the 240-tick horizon referenceGrimoires 361.33 -> 359.40 (-0.21 SE), referenceLibraryDepth 25.09 -> 25.47 (0.53 SE), referenceNodesKnown 46.91 -> 46.96 (0.43 SE); at 2400 ticks referencePeakPopulation 50080 -> 50230 (1.14 SE) and referenceLibraryDepth 9.94 -> 12.84 (0.89 SE). The single exception is referencePeakPopulation on the horizon gate, 353 -> 365, at 3.02 SE against a tolerance of 3.00 -- a hair over, on a max statistic, and in the same direction and magnitude as the noise in every other figure. THE MECHANISM IS RNG RE-KEYING, NOT A RULE CHANGE, and it is worth naming precisely because it is the whole of the movement. The world step now materializes five territory-holding entities on the first tick of every universe. Entity handles are what deriveActorStream keys on (contracts.md 6), so every entity created after them takes a different handle and therefore a different per-actor stream. Nothing about the arithmetic changed for these runs: the reference universe's academy is sited at the DOCUMENTED DEFAULT, which resolves to arable-lowland, whose site capacity multiplier is fp(1024) by construction (it is the reference kind) and whose libraryUpkeepMultiplier is also fp(1024). Both siting mechanisms are therefore exactly neutral in every run these three gates measure, and territory-holdings.test.ts proves the third quantity is untouched: the state-derived extent deep-equals territoryExtent over the shipped content field for field, so K's base is the same 54,900 it always was and maxCarryingCapacity is the same 109,800. WHAT SITING DOES WHEN IT IS NOT NEUTRAL is measured separately, in university-siting.test.ts, on two universes identical but for one scalar: river-delta gives population 818, K 59,564, 128 students, library depth 22, 85 books; highland-waste gives population 1002, K 39,221, 8 students, library depth 19, 31 books. K moves +51.9% in the predicted direction and population moves -18.4% in the opposite one, because both universes hold the same ground and the delta buys a bigger institution at the cost of the labour that feeds it. NO GOLDEN FIXTURE WAS REGENERATED OR CHANGED; git status over packages/sim-core/test/golden is empty and the 200-year reference run's snapshot hash test passes. All 3901 tests in 277 files pass. This file is a measurement, not a balance claim: release-plan.md forbids a balance claim before 0.5.0, and every magnitude the change added carries tuningStatus untuned. The full record is docs/superpowers/plans/w24-university-siting.md.
